about_the_game:
Dog Jump Demo 

This is a small version of the full game, but do you think it will be an easy demo?

I promise it will be frustrating. But if you're playing with your friends, it will be incredibly fun. There is a finish line at the very top of the course; if you reach that line, you will have completed the demo.

Dog Jump – Are you ready to jump?

Dog Jump is a multiplayer hardcore parkour game where you have to cross the courses and reach the top using your pogo sticks, if you can. Your character will jump non-stop, and you will control your characters when they jump into the air, keeping them balanced as you race with your friends or reach the top together on obstacle-filled courses. Try to reach the highest point by overcoming obstacles and using surrounding objects like trampolines. Every jump is a risk, every landing is a victory.

Headbutt, Knock Down the Opponent and Annoy

It's not just parkour,
Headbutt your friends and disrupt their balance to be the first to reach the top. But beware, they can do the same! Dog Jump challenges your reflexes, timing, and nerves. There is also no compensation for error, one wrong jump at the very top may require you to start from the beginning.

Voice Chat, Chat

You can voice chat with your friends within the game or message each other through the chat. These features both provide communication and increase the fun moments in the game by hearing your falling friend scream.

Customize Your Style

Everyone jumps differently!
Show your personality by customizing your character, with different styled pogo sticks, beautiful pogo shoes, and hats that complete your combination. Don't forget, the characters are very cute animals.

Simple Gameplay, Hard Mastery

Dog Jump offers chaotic fun with simple mechanics.
Every jump, fall, and laugh brings you one step closer to mastery.
Play with your friends or compete online.

short_description: Dog Jump is a multiplayer hardcore parkour game where you and your friends try to reach the top with pogo sticks. Your character never stops jumping. You only control movement and timing. Kick your friends, laugh together, and race towards the finish line!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Dutch, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Swedish
